new_tests.purpose: Fixture and committed-repository tests for source hash checks, missing source findings, report-as-view policy, DAG integrity, P09/P11/P12/P13 coverage, and P14 dry-run boundary.
CI guard that runs the provenance builder, validates the graph schema, checks workflow coverage, and ensures the gate stays static-only.

new_cli_gates.acceptance: Generates a schema-valid provenance graph and exits 0 when there are no blocking findings.

new_artifact_checks: P09 report_index views trace to analysis_summary and P08 source artifacts
P11 stability_report traces to stability metrics, baseline comparison, real evidence, cleanup, and phase summary
P12 scale_ladder_report traces to 10/30 preflight, evidence, rung, cleanup, and phase summary
P13 scale_ladder_report traces to 50/100 preflight, evidence, rung, cleanup, timing, and phase summary
Source artifact hashes and report view hashes are recomputed from disk
Missing source artifacts and hash mismatches produce blocking findings
P14 and 1000-node dry-run artifacts never count as real evidence

expected_initial_failures.reason: L02 provenance builder does not exist before implementation.
tests/provenance does not exist before implementation.
L02 CI provenance test does not exist before implementation.

acceptance_criteria: Provenance graph schema, builder, tests, CI guard, and generated graph exist.
Generated provenance graph validates against schema.
P09, P11, P12, and P13 committed artifacts have required provenance coverage.
Report view outputs cannot be source-of-truth nodes.
Fixture tests prove missing sources, hash drift, cycles, and report view misuse become blocking findings.
No historical phase, gate, report, or audit artifact is modified to hide provenance gaps.
No P14, real Valkey, or fault wrapper command is run.
